Alliance Air flight tyre burst during landing in Bilaspur

An Alliance Air flight carrying 41 passengers experienced a tyre burst while landing at Bilaspur Airport. The incident occurred on an Alliance Air flight from Delhi to Bilaspur. All 41 individuals on board were safely evacuated. The specific cause of the tyre burst was not immediately detailed in the coverage.
